div.p: Discover the lost streets of south-west Carlton. Before the University of Melbourne extended its footprint across this extended precinct, the blocks between Grattan, Swanston, Victoria and Elizabeth streets were home to working families, shops, pubs, factories, churches and schools. The Common Ground Project brings their stories back to light.
We’ve drawn on electoral rolls, city directories, rate books, maps and a range of other archives to build a searchable record of who lived and worked here.
